content.text: New Era: Old World, previously named, and still sometimes referred to as After the end Old World is a total conversion mod set in a neo-medieval period across Afro-Eurasia in the year 2555

The mod is set in a distant future in a post-post-apocalyptic Afro-Eurasia, where a combination of super Solar storm, severe pandemic and supply chain collapse led to the end of the modern world around the year 2000. Centuries have passed and nations have risen and fallen, the whispers of a better old world are just legends, great nations have been forgotten, and new cultures and religions have come into existence.

Gameplay has diverged significantly from vanilla. There are dozens of new religions, hundreds of new cultures, new buildings, laws, governments, execution methods, events, decisions, artifacts, religious features, additionally the map has seen drastic overhaul to add several hundred additional provinces, there are more impassable areas, there is a small doggerland archipelago and the map has been expanded west into the Atlantic. 
Additionally there exists a version of this mod which adds the entirety of East Asia.
